readingLog.title: Site Reliability Engineering: How Google Runs Production Systems
readingLog.author: Niall Richard Murphy, Betsy Beyer, Chris Jones, Jennifer Petoff
readingLog.takeaway: The foundational blueprint for modern production operations, error budgets, blameless post-mortems, and eliminating operational toil.
readingLog.quote: "Hope is not a strategy. Engineering discipline and well-defined SLOs are."

readingLog.title: Designing Data-Intensive Applications
readingLog.author: Martin Kleppmann
readingLog.takeaway: The gold standard for understanding how distributed data stores, replication logs, and consensus protocols survive failures gracefully.
readingLog.quote: "Reliability is continuing to work correctly, even when things go wrong."

readingLog.title: Building Secure and Reliable Systems
readingLog.author: Heather Adkins, Betsy Beyer, Paul Blankinship (Google Press)
readingLog.takeaway: How Google integrates security directly into site reliability engineering and systems design from day zero rather than as an afterthought.
readingLog.quote: "Systems are only as reliable as they are secure, and only as secure as they are reliable."

readingLog.title: The Staff Engineer's Path
readingLog.author: Tanya Reilly
readingLog.takeaway: A pragmatic guide to navigating technical leadership, driving cross-team architectural consensus, and influencing organizational strategy.
readingLog.quote: "Your job is not just to have good ideas, but to build shared understanding and momentum around them."
